integrity: Exact proof and standalone deterministic integer checker included; finite calculations are corroboration only. No independent review or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only heptagonal self-maps and the congruence monoid H_10 are classified. Only the distinction between singleton and nonsingleton length sets is claimed, not complete length sets. General zero-sum/block-monoid background is prior art; historical priority for the explicit four-pattern specialization remains subject to independent study.
title: Four exact residue obstructions to half-factoriality of a heptagonal self-map
